$comment: Experiment T8: what a renderer must know to draw text where PowerPoint draws it. Regenerate with tools/ground-truth/render/text/analyse.ts. Lengths are points unless a field says otherwise.

flip.asks: what a flipped shape does to its text
flip.says: flipH does nothing to the text; flipV turns the whole block 180 degrees; neither mirrors

rotation.asks: the angle the glyphs are drawn at
rotation.says: the text turns by the shape rotation plus a:bodyPr/@rot, and @upright="1" drops the shape rotation

upright-box.asks: the rectangle a:bodyPr/@upright lays the text out in
upright-box.says: the frame's own extents, swapped when the rotation snaps to 90 or 270, centred on the frame

line-box.asks: which run sets the height of a line holding several sizes
line-box.says: the line box is 1.2 times the largest size on the line, whatever the order

baseline.asks: how far below the top of the line box the baseline sits
baseline.says: the line box is split between ascent and descent in the face's own proportion

line-advance.asks: how far below one line the next one sits
line-advance.says: the next line's top is exactly this line's box below this line's top

align.asks: where each line starts inside the content box
align.says: a justifying alignment starts at the left edge; ctr and r anchor the line less whatever spaces it ends with

justify.asks: which lines a justifying alignment stretches
justify.says: just, justLow and thaiDist leave the last line alone; dist stretches every line

trailing-space.asks: whether a trailing space counts towards the width an alignment anchors
trailing-space.says: alignment uses the width without the trailing spaces, which hang past the edge

decoration-scale.asks: whether a rule keeps its place when the size changes
decoration-scale.says: offset and thickness are both fractions of the em, so a rule scales with the text

decoration-face.asks: whether either cheap way of placing a rule reproduces PowerPoint
decoration-face.says: neither: the browser's own text-decoration is in the wrong place for every face, and one offset does not fit eight faces, so the offsets are a measured table

decoration-extent.asks: whether an underline runs under the spaces a line ends with
decoration-extent.says: the spaces a line ends with are not underlined

baseline-shift.asks: how far a:rPr/@baseline moves a run and at what size it is drawn
baseline-shift.says: the run rises by @baseline per cent of the size it asked for, drawn at two thirds of it

caps.asks: what a:rPr/@cap draws, and at what size
caps.says: cap="all" uppercases at the full size; cap="small" uppercases the lowercase at four fifths of it

runs.asks: whether a run boundary changes the advances either side of it
runs.says: a run boundary splits the drawing calls and nothing else: the kern crosses it
